events.title: The Drifting Wreck
events.body: A merchant hull lies on her side in the swell, masts gone, hold half under. Something glints below the waterline. The tide is turning, and she won't float much longer.

choices.label: Strip the deck
choices.resultText: Brass fittings, a purse in a dead man's coat. Small, but it's yours.

choices.label: Dive the hold
choices.resultText: Your diver comes up with a full chest, or comes up empty-handed and bleeding from the timbers.

choices.label: Leave her to the sea
choices.resultText: You hold your course. Nothing happens, and behind you the wreck slips under.

events.title: A Peddler's Sloop
events.body: A little sloop runs up her colours and comes alongside. Her captain has crates of tonics lashed to the rail and a nervous smile. He names a fair price, which is how you know he wants to be gone.

choices.label: Buy two tonics
choices.resultText: Two bottles for forty gold. Cheaper than any port will sell them.

choices.label: Let him see your captain
choices.resultText: He takes one look at the beard and calls it a gift. He sails off fast.

choices.label: Wave him off
choices.resultText: Nothing changes hands. The sloop goes off looking for an easier crew.

events.title: Castaway on a Spar
events.body: A man clings to a broken spar, cutlass still in his belt. He says he was a master-at-arms until his ship went down two nights ago. He'll pay for a ride to shore with the heavy purse around his neck, or work off his passage drilling your crew.

choices.label: Put him to work
choices.resultText: Three days of blade drill on a rolling deck. He keeps his purse, and your crew stops dropping their guard.

choices.label: Take the purse
choices.resultText: You row him to a sandbar and take your fare. A fair trade, more or less.

events.title: The Hidden Shoal
events.body: The keel grinds and the whole ship shudders to a stop. You've run onto a sandbank the chart never showed. The tide is going out, and the hull groans with every wave.

choices.label: Force her off
choices.resultText: Full sail drags her free, and leaves half the keel on the sand.

choices.label: Over the side and push
choices.resultText: Waist-deep in cold water, the crew heaves her clear. The hull barely notices. The crew's shoulders do.

choices.label: Lighten the hold
choices.resultText: Over go stores and a chest of coin. She floats off clean, and you're poorer for it.

notes:
Revision of early-waters: 3 Good, 1 Bad, layers 1-3, weight 1.

Fixes:
- DriftingWreck (major, dominant gamble): 'Strip the deck' goes from +40 to +50. 'Dive the hold' is now 50/50: +120 gold, or 0 gold and -30 HP to one random crew member. That's an average of 60 gold with a real HP cost half the time, against a sure 50. The result text now covers the empty-handed branch.
- CastawayOnASpar (major, trap with a full crew): I didn't wait on CrewCountAtMost. I took Recruit out. The castaway now trades either his purse (+60 gold) or crew drill (+50 XP to All, half a level each). Both choices work at any crew size, so there's no trap and still a real gold-vs-growth choice. The body explains both offers. When Brandon adds a CrewCountAtMost requirement, a 'Sign him on' (Recruit Swordsman, CrewCountAtMost 3) choice can come back.
- HiddenShoal (major, free with no gold): 'Lighten the hold' now needs MinGold 60. 'Force her off' and 'Over the side and push' have no requirements and stay available.

Unchanged: PeddlersSloop wasn't flagged.

Open questions for Brandon: (1) Sloop sells 2 HealthRestore for 40 total, below the shop's 30 each. Is that discount OK? (2) Does GiveItem fail gracefully when the inventory is full (6)? (3) Idea: a CrewCountAtMost requirement, so Recruit events can disable their button cleanly.
